Signed by President William H. Taft Monday, January 31, 1910

1910 CSR 112

649146Executive Order 1160 — Authorizing Appointment of J. F. Boepple as Shell Expert in Bureau of Fisheries Without Examination1910President of the United States

Mr. J. F. Boepple may be appointed to the position of shell expert at $1,200 per annum in the Biological Station, Fairport, Iowa, Bureau of Fisheries, Department of Commerce and Labor, without examination under the civil-service rules.

Wm. H. Taft.

The White House,

January 31, 1910.
